text:
Olivia: Quick sync — we need a concise taxonomy for partner asks so we can decide what goes into pilot vs backlog. thinking 3 buckets: Integrations, Blocking QA, Nice-to-have UI polish. thoughts?
Sam: Agree. can we map to engineering SLAs too? e.g., `P0` -> 1-week triage, `P1` -> 4 weeks, `P2` -> next-planning?
Nina: From CS: partners expect a response within 48h on scope decisions. If we miss that, we lose momentum. could we commit to an internal owner for replies?
Ben: Solutions engineering can take initial triage for integration asks. we'll flag ones that need infra changes.
Lee: For design asks, if it's purely UX wording vs new flow, mark as `UX-Tweak` and low effort. we should avoid surface-level asks blocking pilots.
Olivia: Proposed short rubric (one-liner each):
- "Integrations (I)": needs API changes or infra work, affects request/response contract.
- "Blocking QA (B)": correctness or safety regressions that prevent launch.
- "Surface UX (U)": copy, minor flow tweaks, docs.
- "Ask Escalation (E)": partner requests new model capability or custom weights.
Sam: Suggest numeric priority code: I/P0, B/P0, E/P1, U/P2. keeps it compact in tickets.
Nina: Can we add a partner-facing SLA doc blurb? one paragraph that says "we'll triage within 48h, commit ETA if P0/P1". I can draft.
Olivia: Yes. Also need a rule for scope negotiation during 2-week pilot windows: if it's P0/B we address during pilot; P1 we schedule in next minor release unless partner upsells.
Ben: Ops note: if it's infra-heavy (I and requires new capacity config) we need a minimum 3-week runway. call that out.
Maria: Legal flag: if ask requires data retention or new logging, escalate to legal. that'll be `E` but tag with `legal-review` label.
Sam: Implementation suggestion: add labels in our ticketing = `partner:I`, `partner:B`, `partner:U`, `partner:E` + `sla:48h/1w/4w`. makes dashboards trivial.
Olivia: OK action items: 
- Nina to draft partner-facing SLA blurb (48h triage language).
- Ben to own integration triage playbook + 3-week runway callout.
- Sam to add labels + quick ticket template.
- Lee to create a UX triage checklist for pilots.
- Maria to write legal escalation trigger list.
Nina: I'll post a 1-paragraph SLA blurb by EOD.
Ben: I'll sketch the playbook and share a short checklist tomorrow morning.
Sam: I'll add labels + ticket template PR to the internal repo after lunch.
Lee: UX checklist — will include when to decline scope vs accept quick patch.
Maria: I'll list legal triggers and sample approvals flow.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: none — this thread contains decisions only. :robot_face:
Olivia: One more: decision on compensation/credits if partner asks P1/P2 that we decide to scope in pilot — do we offer credits or future roadmap priority? Need a short policy.
Nina: My recommendation: credits for infra/time-heavy work (I) during pilot; for U-level work, offer prioritized backlog + visibility.
Ben: +1. credits only when we allocate engineering time within pilot window. track via ticket estimate.
Olivia: OK decision logged: credits optional, reserved for infra or blocking work performed during pilot. we'll add this to the partner SLA blurb.
Olivia: I'll turn these AIs into a checklist doc and link in the partner intake. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
